translation: (Eight cun below Zhangmen (LR13), in the depression above the jian gu bone.) Following the flank and ribs it ascends obliquely above the elbow, joining Hand Yangming and hand-foot Taiyang at Binao (LI14). (Seven cun above the elbow, in the crevice-depression between the two sinews, one cun below Jianyu (LI15).) Passing in front of the shoulder, it joins Hand Shaoyang at Naohui (TE13) and Tianliao (TE15). (Naohui is in front of the shoulder, in the middle hollow three cun from the shoulder tip. Tianliao is in the middle hollow on the superior border of the bone at the top of the supraclavicular fossa.) Then it joins hand-foot Shaoyang and Foot Yangming at Jianjing (GB21).
